explanations: Logout, logout-everywhere and rotation all revoke refresh tokens by setting revokedAt, but refresh() checks only that the record exists and hasn't expired. It never checks revokedAt. A signed-out, rotated or password-reset token can therefore still be exchanged for fresh tokens for up to 30 days, and each exchange produces a new active record, which is how the device keeps streaming. The fix rejects revoked records. It also treats a revoked token coming back as a sign the token was copied (reuse detection): it revokes the whole device session, so neither the attacker's newer token nor the replayed one works.
